sources.title: OLMo 2 13B Instruct · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: The 13B counterpart to OLMo 2 7B, sharing the same full-open stack: Dolma pretraining data, OLMo trainer code, WandB training logs, and Apache-2.0 weights. Post-trained with the Tülu 3 recipe of SFT, DPO, and RLVR.

sources.title: OLMo-2-1124-13B-Instruct · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: See OLMo 2 Preview Post trained Models for the colleciton of the legacy models. Release Documentation OLMo 2 13B Instruct November 2024 is post trained variant of the OLMo 2 13B November 2024 model, which has undergone supervised finetuning on an OLMo specific variant of the Tülu 3 dataset, and finally RLVR training using this data.

sources.title: OLMo from Ai2
sources.snippet: The OLMo 2 model family OLMo 2 32B OLMo 2 32B is the most capable and largest model in the OLMo 2 family, scaling up the OLMo 2 training recipe used for our 7B and 13B models. It is trained up to 6T tokens and post-trained using Tulu 3.1.
